third_party_evaluations.summary: Foundational networking, IP services, security and automation (200-301 v1.1).

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded one-year networking profile, security coverage and production relevance fit associate implementation knowledge; NICCS recognition does not imply broad security architecture ownership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded networking, IP services, security and automation coverage supports an associate operator with one year of experience. The NICCS listing adds context, while the vendor scope and lack of a recorded practical cap the signal.

alex-novak.rationale: Networking, IP services, security and automation form a useful operational toolchain at the recorded one-year level. Vendor specificity and the absence of documented senior delivery responsibility keep it at associate.
